hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Angela has one of the fastest level 1 wave clears in the game. Be sure to hit Skill 1 on the entire minion wave twice; then you can look to roam with Skill 2 to take jungle camps and catch enemies off guard.

## Teamfight
In teamfights, be patient with your combo. Look for high-value targets that you can hit with your skills, but be sure to stand behind your frontline so you don't get caught. Always try to fight around vision and use bushes to surprise enemies with your combo.

## Tips & Tricks
One-shot combo Skill 2 > Skill 1 > Ultimate
Hide in bushes and use Angela combo before enemies see you
Always manually aim Angela's skills for a better hit rate
When you are about to get hit by crowd control, use your Ultimate for immunity.

avoid_when: The enemy already invested in magic resist and shields that absorb committed burst windows
The enemy plays sustained damage rather than burst, which shields cannot absorb in single windows
The enemy already drafted Han Xin and Gao Changgong, who counter data identifies as direct answers to Angela.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
In the early game, you want to prioritze farming and last-hitting minions, contesting around neutral objectives, and looking to use your range to poke enemies when they step up to last hit. Play around your cooldowns. If you have Skill 1 and either Skill 2/3 up, you can look to use these on the enemy hero and use Ao'Yin's long-range auto attack to deal a lot of poke damage.

## Teamfights
Your goal is to stay behind your frontline and watch out for enemy threats. Save your Ultimate Infinity Vastness for when you are about to die so you can reposition to safety. With Ao'Yin's long range, you can look to flash in with your Skills to finish off low-health enemies.

## Tips & Tricks
Having 2 of the same soul will increase the effectiveness. For example, 2 Fire souls means your auto attacks will deal more damage
If you have mixed souls and want 2 of the same soul, tap the soul you want double of
You can change souls whilst in the air with your Ultimate

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Skill 2, Whirling Strike, can help you clear the first minion wave quickly to get level 2 before your opponent, giving you an advantage that you can use to win early trades. You want to take short trades so you can heal back up from your Passive every time. Each short chip of damage will help you win the Early Game. With this early advantage, you can look to secure Space Sprite and roam to help your team.

## Teamfights
Teamfights are a struggle for Arthur. You don't have a lot of mobility, so it's difficult for you to get onto the back line with your Ultimate and Skill 1. Try to stay in bushes to surprise the enemy carries and use your silence to stop high-impact skills on the enemy team. Always stay close enough to your team so they can back up your engage, and don't chase too far, as you can be kited very easily.

## Tips & Tricks
Start trades with Skill 1 for more damage on your auto attacks and other skills
You can auto attack after using Skill 1 to dash anywhere even over walls

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Augran has one of the fastest jungle clear speeds in the entire game. With Skill 1 Path of Passing, he can walk through terrain and execute jungle camps with his auto attacks. With his mobility and execute, it also allows him to invade very effectively, with both execute and smite allowing him to steal enemy jungle camps away, giving him an early advantage. When looking for ganks, Augran relies on his slows and team to CC enemies so he can finish them off with his execute.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, positioning is key. You want to be close enough so you can auto attack and execute enemies, but you also don't want to be too close that you can be burst down from the enemies' crowd control. Save your Ultimate Conductor of Soul for the right moment. You don't need to always use it at the start of a fight. Sometimes you need to save it for the heal or use it to be able to get Steer State to execute low-health enemies.

## Tips & Tricks
Only use Skill 1 a 2nd time to enter Steer State when you can execute enemies or jungle camps
If you want to quickly enter Steer State to execute enemies, use your Ultimate
Combo Skill 2 and Skill 1 to gain a burst of movement speed to catch up with enemies

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
In the early game, use Skill 2 Earworm on enemies to deal damage and stun them when they want to walk up and last-hit minions. You can use Skill 2 when the enemy is trying to stand behind minions, and it will still bounce onto them, giving you super reliable damage and crowd control. When roaming, use Skill 1 Healing Hymn to give yourself movement speed so you are the first one on the rotations to help your team.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, your main goal is to keep your Marksman and Mage alive. You have excellent aoe healing that can keep them both healthy at the same time. If assassins look to dive your carries, use your Ultimate early to give them defences to help them survive enemy burst. Skill 2 can also be used to crowd control the enemy that is trying to dive.

## Tips & Tricks
Skill 2 can bounce on minions and monsters to help reach enemy heroes
Your Ultimate not only heals but also gives Physical and Magical defence, so don't leave it too late

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
For most of the Early Game, Chicha will be in melee form, which is her weakest state. You can use minions or jungle monsters to get 4 stacks of your passive, so once you go to the lane, you only need to auto-attack once, then use Skill 2 World-Splitting Spear to deal huge poke damage. Most of the Early Game will be you sitting underneath the tower last hitting minions, and waiting for your Overkill Form before looking to trade.

## Teamfights
Before entering a teamfight, make sure to attack jungle monsters or minions to get 4 stacks. This is essential to Chicha's playstyle since her Overkill Form is what will win teamfights. Be patient with your Ultimate Return of the Armsmaster; wait for the right moment and target before using it for huge damage. You can use Skill 1 and Skill 2 during your Ultimate to help gap close and finish off enemies.

## Tips & Tricks
Attack monsters or minions 4 times before joining a fight so you can enter Overkill Form straight away for maximum damage
Use Skill 1 and Skill 2 before entering Overkill Form since the cooldown gets reduced
Always use Skill 2 as soon as you enter Overkill since it has a long cooldown
Make sure to use the attack button when using your Ultimate to deal damage

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Focus on farming minions and jungle camps until you get your first items. Consort Yu scales with attack speed, and with no attack speed early on, she can struggle. Use Skill 1 Oak Bolt to last-hit minions and poke the enemy at a safe range. Skill 2 Protecting Winds will save your life more than you think. Save it for when the enemy markman want to commit or for enemy jungle ganks.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, stay behind your frontline and hit the first enemy in front of you. Don't use Skill 2 too early; instead, save it for when the enemy is looking to dive onto you. Keep moving and repositioning in fights; your slows from your passive help you kite well in teamfights. Consort Yu's ultimate Vaulting Shot is a great chasing tool to stun enemies but can also be used to escape danger, so use it wisely.

## Tips & Tricks
Use Consort Yu's passive to attack and kite enemies
Try to bait enemies in when you have Skill 2 up to surprise them and kill them in a 1 vs 1
Consort Yu's Ultimate is best used as a reposition tool if you get jumped on by enemies

avoid_when: The enemy stacks crowd control that interrupts the engage before damage goes out
The team fight will happen in cramped jungle spaces where poke ranges are minimized
The enemy already drafted Luna and Diaochan, who counter data identifies as direct answers to Consort Yu.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
Da Qiao rewards good map awareness over mechanics. Her Twin Portals can win games by collapsing your whole team onto an isolated enemy, reinforcing a contested objective, or yanking allies out of a fight that's gone wrong. Use Lover's Bond by staying close to your carry for the speed and heal, poke with Blessing Wave, and treat Lucky Step as your safety button. The hardest part is choosing the right moment to portal - when in doubt, use it to save rather than to gamble on a risky engage.

## Key Combos
- Ultimate to teleport your team into a gank, then Skill 1 to heal during the fight.
- Ultimate defensively to pull a diving ally out of a lost fight.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Daji is weak early since she won't have her full combo. Try to clear minion waves, but if the enemy has priority, stay under the tower and last-hit minions. Avoid trading before reaching level 4 and instead try to roam with your jungle to set them up for success.

## Teamfights
Since Daji's crowd control is single target you'll need to be patient and pick the right target to stun. Do not start fights and stay behind your tank at all times. Play around bushes to catch enemies off guard, and after using your combo, make sure to back off and reposition until your skills become available again.

## Tips & Tricks

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
In the early game, Devara can use his ranged attacks to punish the enemy when they want to walk up and last-hit minions. When looking to trade, always use Skill 1 Thunderblaze to gain a shield and an empowered auto attack to win every time. Always use a skill when at full energy. Do not waste the downtime of stacking your passive with auto attacks. Even if you use Skill 1 to get an empowered auto attack to help clear the wave or jungle camp, it all helps his tempo.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, as Devara, you need to play patiently. You don't want to be the first hero that goes in. You want to use your range and mobility to kite in fights and poke the enemy. Use your Ultimate when you are about to get hit by crowd control or need to escape; however, be careful because you can still take damage and die whilst transforming. After being transformed, you can look to play aggressively with his bonus damage and quick passive stacking.

## Tips & Tricks
Always auto-attack after using a Skill to deal extra magic damage and restore health
Skill 1 can be used to dash over walls
Stack your passive on minions or monsters before trading or joining a teamfight

abilities.desc: Dolia takes on mermaid form when in water (rivers are also considered water), reducing the slows taken by 50% and returning life and mana every second. The mermaid form's Basic Attacks will shoot water arrows for ranged damage. Dolia's [Recovery] is replaced with [Mermaid's Gift], which allows her to create a pact with a selected teammate, and prioritizes her pacted teammate when using [Celestial Melody].
abilities.name: Mermaid's Gift

abilities.desc: Dolia chants 4 sound waves that spread outward, the first 3 dealing spell damage and 10% slow. The 4th deals more spell damage and 50% slow for 1 second. The sound waves also echo when they hit an enemy, dealing spell damage to those they touch and, if released in water, sending waves of water knocking back nearby enemies (knockback of enemies around you has a stun effect). Non-heroic units provoke a much smaller echo, dealing only 50% of the damage.
abilities.name: Ode

abilities.desc: Lam enters “Submerged” state, greatly increasing his Movement Speed for 3 seconds. When the duration ends, Lam leaps out of the water, immediately restoring 50% of this skill’s cooldown. While in Submerged state, casting the skill again will cause Lam to surface early, dealing 300 (+120% Bonus Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1.5 seconds. Passive: While in river terrain, the Submerged state has no time limit. If an enemy hero with below 30% Health appears within 1500 range, Lam gains 450 Movement Speed.
abilities.name: Wavemaker

abilities.desc: After Dolia briefly chants, refresh the skill with the longest current cooldown of a friendly within range, taking more cooldown from yourself. If a teammate's skill is not used after being refreshed, [Celestial Melody]'s cooldown recovery speed can be accelerated by 20/30/40%. Teammates do not consume Mana or Energy when using the skill for 5 seconds after the skill is refreshed, and the beatdown benefit caused by the skill is split equally with Dolia. Refreshing skills for contracted teammates is prioritized, followed by non-contracted teammates, or refreshing your own skills if there are no teammates nearby. Failure to refresh a skill returns most of the cooldown of [Celestial Melody].
abilities.name: Celestial Melody

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Start in the mid lane and use Skill 1 to help clear the wave. Then rotate to farm lane to protect and heal your marksman. Hide in bushes to get vision and threaten your poke. Always fight near the river so you can knock back with Skill 1 and deal more damage with your auto attacks.

## Teamfights
Before a teamfight starts, stay with your carrys in the backline and keep track of which ally has the most impactful ultimate. Keep your Skill 2 healing on teammates that are taking damage and use your crowd control to peel for your marksman or mage.

## Tips & Tricks
Always position near pools or in the river to enhance your auto attacks and Skill 1 Ode
Save your Ultimate Celestial Melody for teammates' Ultimates to give them more impact in fights
Dolia can dash forward with Skill 2 Wavemaker whilst Skill 1 is active making it easier for you to hit the 4th soundwave

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Since Dun is a tank, your early game should be focused on full clearing the jungle to quickly reach level 4. Once you have your Ultimate Unruly Blade, you can start looking for ganks with your incredible crowd control. When ganking, use your skills to stun and knockup the enemy, then follow up with your basic attacks.

## Teamfights
Dun's primary goal is to start fights with his Ultimate to close the gap and stun enemy heroes. When possible, try to target the backline, so your team can follow up with their damage. Stay in the front line and protect your carrys when possible. If they get jumped on you can turn around and use your crowd control to peel for them to keep them alive.

## Tips & Tricks
To guarantee the knockup from Skill 1 Wind Slash, use your Ultimate Unruly Blade to stun the enemy first
Dun's Ultimate doesn't need to hit an enemy for you to travel so that you can use it as an escape tool
Use skill 2, Gale's Benediction, at the start of the fight to get a shield and increase your damage with your basic attacks

avoid_when: The enemy stacks crowd control that interrupts the engage before damage goes out
Your team lacks the follow-up damage to convert your control windows into kills
The enemy already drafted Han Xin, Li Bai, and Wukong, who counter data identifies as direct answers to Dun.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Erin is very weak in the early game. You want to prioritze farming and last-hitting minions and avoid unnecessary trades. Erin's passive can be used to poke enemies safely. You do not want to waste your 2nd Skill Twirl aggressively; instead, save it for escaping ganks. 

## Teamfights
In teamfights, focus on kiting; keep moving while attacking to keep stacking towards your ultimate. Position behind your frontline and save 2nd Skill Twirl for when assassins try to jump onto you. When you are far enough ahead, you can look to dash aggressively and use your Ultimate to burst high-value enemy heroes.

## Tips & Tricks
Use Skill 2 Twirl during your Ultimate to get closer to enemy heroes
Cancel your Ultimate if there are no enemies nearby to save Laurel stacks. Your Ultimate has a low cooldown and can be used again after a few seconds
At 2 stacks of energy, you can auto attack and then use Skill 2 Twirl to double dash. Very effective for escaping or trying to get to the enemy backline.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Focus on farming and last-hitting minions to maximise the amount of gold you get. Use Skill 1 before getting to the minion wave so you can pierce through all the minions at once to help with your clear. Skill 2 can be used on minions to close the gap to the enemy to help you poke or help you escape danger.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, always keep an eye on your positioning. Stay behind your team so you don't get jumped on by assassins. When using Flowborn marksman Ultimate, you will be a little exposed, so be sure to use it in a safe position. Save Skill 2 to reposition, whether that's away from the enemy to escape or close the gap to help you finish off low-health enemy heroes.

## Tips & Tricks
In base Passive: Early Game > Damage ; Late Game > Movement Speed
Use Ultimate twice to levitate over walls
Skill 2 can be used to help last-hit minions or for mobility in fights

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Focus on farming in the early game and avoid unnecessary trades or fights until you get some attack speed and critical rate from your core items. Use Skill 2 Silent Arrow to poke the enemy and interrupt them from engaging. Remember, do not use Skill 1 when attacking minions or jungle monsters, as it will waste your mana, and you'll struggle to stay in lane.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to stay behind your frontline and abuse your range advantage from Skill 1 Enchanted Arrows. Even though you don't have much mobility, the movement speed from your Ultimate Sphere of Purity can help with kiting in the late game. If you are chasing or kiting away from your Ultimate, make sure to use it again to break the circle so you can get some extra movement speed.

## Tips & Tricks
Only use Skill 1 when attacking heroes in trades and teamfights. Don't waste your mana attacking minions/monsters
Always try to position yourself inside Garo's Ultimate for the increased movement speed and critical rate.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
In the Early Game, Haya can line up and clear the first minion wave with 3 casts of her Skill 1 Crescent Wave. This will give you time to roam to other lanes to help them gain an advantage, or you can help your jungle clear camps. Always keep an eye out on your passive moon crystals since this is your main resource for using skills. If your passive is charging up, play safe until you can use your skills again.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, stay in the backline and let your tanks protect you. Don't waste your Ultimate on the first target you see; sometimes it's best to wait until you get jumped on by enemy assassins or use it on the enemy Mage/Marksman to take them out of the fight. When fighting around the Tyrant or Overlord, use your Ultimate on the enemy jungler to help your team secure the objective.

## Tips & Tricks

Use Skill 2's stun to give you a better chance of hitting enemies with Haya's Skill 1 true damage
Skill 2 can be used on jungle camps to help rotate faster around the map
Use Haya's Ultimate to give you damage reduction when being jumped on by assassins

avoid_when: The enemy has hard engage that closes distance through poke patterns
Your team needs a jungle pick more than Haya's specialty, leaving the role unfilled if you commit here.
The enemy team is built around answers to Ranged Harass, removing the windows Haya's kit needs to perform.

Save your Skill 1 Arrow Volley until you have reached maximum stacks of your passive for maximum damage output
Burning Sun Arrow is a global Ultimate, meaning it can go across the whole map, giving you opportunities to help other lanes

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Kaizer is weak before he reaches Level 4 and gets access to his Ultimate Invincible Warrior, so you want to focus on full clearing your jungle and going to lanes to share gold and experience. Once you reach Level 4, you can start to look for ganks and isolated enemies since Kaizer's passive gives his basic attacks and Skill 2 more damage when hitting a single enemy. 

## Teamfights
In teamfights, be patient with your Ultimate. If you use it too early, the enemy will just back off, then look to engage after your Ultimate ends. Landing Skill 1 Vortex Brand is the most important part of Kaizer's kit, slowing enemy heroes and allowing you to follow up with Skill 2 and basic attacks. Be sure to prioritze the right target in fights. If an enemy hero has too much mobility for you to chase down, then don't waste your skills on them; instead, look for an easier target.

## Tips & Tricks
Skill 2's empowered auto attack can be used to dash over walls
Always auto attack after using Skill 2 Blade Tempest
Don't waste Skill 1. Not only does it do damage but its important to hit for the sustain and movement speed

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
For the first minion wave, you can use Skill 1 Arcane Assault and aim it so it hits all the minions. If you do this with both your charges, you will proc his passive, allowing you to quickly clear the first wave. You can use this advantage to roam and try to help your other lanes. You can consistently do this throughout the early game and look to roam and snowball the early game.

## Teamfights
Kongming can be very challenging to play in teamfights. He's not your traditional mid lane mage that sits back and uses abilities from range; he wants to get in the face of enemies utilising his passive and burst damage. You want to keep yourself alive and look to cleanup fights when heroes are low on health. If you can use his Ultimate Winning Strategy to finish off heroes, you can use it multiple times in a teamfight. However, one misposition or one wrong dash and you could get caught and one-shot since Kongming is very squishy.

## Tips & Tricks
Position and use Skill 1 where you can hit all 3 orbs to get maximum stacks for his Passive
Never use Kongming's Ultimate at the start of a fight
Use minions and monsters to get stacks for your passive before joining a teamfight

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
In the early game, you want to farm safely before hitting your item spikes. The only time you should look to trade is when Skill 1 Rolling Raid is available. Learning the range of your empowered auto attack and where to roll will help you win every trade. You can also use Skill 1 defensively to escape ganks and dodge enemy skill shots. Try to hit Skill 2 Frag Grenade before going in, helping you land your empowered basic attack and deal more damage.

## Teamfights
As a marksman, make sure to stay behind your frontline. Be careful when using Skill 1. If you roll forward and get caught, you will have no mobility to escape. Remember you can roll over walls to reposition in fights. With your increased range from Skill 1, try to burst high-priority targets like the enemy's marksman or mage. 

## Tips & Tricks
Skill 1 can be used to roll over walls to chase enemies or escape danger
Use Skill 2 before your burst, the slow makes it harder for enemies to escape

If Lam is submerged with Skill 1 in a river, the duration never runs out
Lam's Ultimate can be used behind enemies to push them into your team

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game

Li Xin is not the strongest fighter before level 4. Avoid unnecessary fights until you get your form upgrade; then you can start pressuring your lane opponent with Li Xin's long-range harass in Domination Form.

## Teamfights

With this build, you want to focus on using Domination Form. Position like you are a ranged carry, using your skills and empowered attacks to deal damage. Only dash in when you know you can guarantee a kill.

## Tips and Tricks

Focus on using Domination Form for long-range poke from your skills and empowered attacks
You do not need to use all 4 charges of Blade Flurry. 1 is enough to get your empowered attack
Save Righteous Charge for dodging and creating distance

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
At level 1, you want to take Skill 2 and start in the mid lane. With your tankiness, you can walk up and hit all the minions with Skill 2 to help your mid lane clear the wave. After, you want to go to the farm lane to protect your carry. Remember that Skill 1 cooldown can be reset when you hit Skill 2 so you can Skill 1 > Skill 2 > Skill 1 for free damage during the early game.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to be the main initiator. You have great AOE knockups with both Skill 1 and your Ultimate. When using your Ultimate, if the enemies are trying to escape, you can flash at the last second to reposition your knockup to surprise enemies in fights. This initiation alone can win teamfights for your team. You can also combo your knockup with Frigid Charge to stun enemies when they land back from your knockup, making it impossible for them to escape.

## Tips & Tricks
You can flash during the 3rd strike on Lian Po's Ultimate to reposition so you can hit his knockup
Skill 1 can be used to dash over walls
If enemies are within range when charging Skill 2, Skill 1 resets for an extra dash

The enemy stacks anti-tank items like armor penetration and percent-HP damage, melting front-liners quickly

- Use Sky-Piercer Sweep to peel enemies off your carry

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Luara's early game is very weak. With her low attack range, it's extremely difficult to walk up and try to trade efficiently, so most of the time you want to stay underneath the tower and farm safely. Start with Skill 2 to safely farm from range and try to poke the enemy at the same time. Skill 1 can help you clear minion waves and gives you extra movement speed to run out of the enemy Marksman's attack range and escape ganks.

## Teamfights
With Luara's low range, it's always best to attack the first enemy in front of you. Always fight around terrain so you can use your Skill 1 to jump over walls to escape danger. Your Ultimate Blazing Glare is a game changer. It does insane damage, and blinding is a very strong tool to have, where enemies' attacks and skills will miss you. It's best to save this for when you get dove on by assassins

## Tips & Tricks
In fights, stay near a wall so you can use Skill 1 to jump over and escape
Use Skill 1 before Skill 2 to get a serpent blade that does damage when Skill 2 hits

avoid_when: The enemy stacks dive and assassins, making it impossible for the marksman to free-cast in fights
Your team needs a support pick more than Luara's specialty, leaving the role unfilled if you commit here.
The enemy team is built around answers to Carry, removing the windows Luara's kit needs to perform.

## Early Game
Focus on farming and last-hitting minions whenever possible. Use Blowfish Grenade Skill 1 to poke enemies, which also gives you an empowered auto attack to increase your damage potential. Try to save Skill 2 for when you get ganked and jumped on to push enemies away.

## Teamfights
Prepare your passive before a fight by just auto-attacking or hitting nearby minions or monsters. Stand behind your front line and hit the closest target. Don't walk too far forward as you have no mobility to escape.

You can auto-attack nothing to stack Luban No.7's passive, so when you get to lane or a fight, your passive will be available straight away
Skill 2 Shark Cannon is a global skill that can be used for vision or to poke/snipe enemy heroes
Always auto attack between skills for maximum damage output. Never use 2 skills one after the other

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Marco Polo's early game is very weak. You want to focus on farming and use Skill 1 Energy Bullets to last-hit minions and poke enemies from range. Save your Skill 2 Quick Step dash for escaping jungle ganks and dodging enemy skill shots. You should only look to trade or go all in when your passive is close so you can deal true damage to the enemy.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to stand behind your front line and use Skill 1 Energy Bullets to stack your passive. Once you've built up your passive you can look to dash in to deal true damage. Keep moving whilst using Skill 1 to kite and dodge skillshots.

## Tips & Tricks
Do not touch the left stick when using your Ultimate, or you'll cancel it
You can use Purify whilst in your Ultimate to stop any crowd control

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Milady has no reliable wave clear early on. You will need to sit under the tower for the first few levels and wait until you have a few robots to help you out. It's vital that you last-hit minions to spawn robots thanks to your passive. After pushing the wave, look for roams to help your jungle or by going into another lane.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, summon your robots early so they can deal damage throughout the fight. Stay behind your backline and use your skills and Ultimate on the first enemy in front of you.

## Tips & Tricks
Use your robots to tank tower shots and help you push towers faster
Make sure to use Skill 1 Air Superiority a 2nd time to split the aircraft for more damage and to slow the enemies
Your robots can tank enemy jungle camps, making it easier for you to take them away

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Start in the mid lane and use Skill 2 to poke the enemy and help your mid laner push the minion wave with your passive. Skill 2 is a strong tool to have early on with its long range and CC potential. After you've cleared the mid wave, look to go into the Farm Lane and continue using Skill 2 to poke and push the enemy back to their tower. Skill 2 can also be used to check bushes when roaming. If you find yourself in any danger, use Skill 1 to dash away to safety.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to continue to use Skill 2 at range to CC the enemy and try to catch isolated targets. You don't want to be the first one to dive in with your Ultimate. Instead, wait for your frontline to dive in first and then follow up with Think Inside the Box to lockdown the enemy. You need to be flexible with your playstyle, as in some instances you need to protect your carries and instead use your Skill 2 and Ultimate to peel for them.

## Tips & Tricks
You can auto-attack and stack Mozi's passive whilst walking around to get your 4th empowered attack at any time
Use Skill 1 to reposition in fights for your Skill 2 or Ultimate

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Nuwa has one of the worst minion clear speeds in early levels. You want to play under the tower and play reactive to where the enemy mid lane is rotating. Rotate the opposite way and try to impact other lanes. When you have access to Skill 3 Emergence, it becomes much easier to roam and helps you get back to mid lane quicker to secure minion gold and experience.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to take control of the fights with your boxes. They can be used for damage, rotations and blocking enemies' path. You have decent self-peel with your knockback, but it can be difficult to land, and with your global Ultimate you can always make an impact in a fight.

## Tips & Tricks
One-Shot combo - Skill 2 > Skill 2 > Skill 1 > Ultimate
Skill 2's box can be used to traverse over terrain
Skill 3 can be used for vision and cancelled so you don't travel

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Wang Zhaojun has a pretty solid early game. Her wave clear isn't the best early on, but when you rotate, your crowd control can be clutch in skirmishes. Don't waste Frigid Prison Skill 2 for poke. Instead, keep it for setting up kills and punishing enemies who step too far forward.

## Teamfight
In teamfights, be patient with Frigid Prison Skill 2 and only use it when you can guarantee it hits an enemy. Usually it's good to wait for your team to use their crowd control, then follow up afterwards. Position yourself in the back line and use your Ultimate Winter is Here to protect yourself and zone enemies.

## Tips & Tricks
You can auto-attack whilst standing still to get your enhanced basic attack when you get to lane or at the start of a fight
Use Skill 1 Shattered Ice to slow enemies, making Skill 2 Frigid Prison easier to hit
You can use Skill 1 and Skill 2 to check bushes before enterting them

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Wukong has decent early jungle clear speed with his Skill 2 mobility and empowered auto attacks. He also has a lot of burst damage early on, and great crowd control with his Ultimate Golden Cudgel, so you can look for early ganks to try and snowball the early game; however, if you make a mistake and fall behind, it becomes extremely difficult to come back into the game.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, as an assassin, Wukong wants to hide in bushes and engage from unexpected angles. You don't want to be the first one to engage in the front line. You need to completely ignore the tanks and focus on their Marksman or Mage to one-shot them with your burst combo. This is your main goal; failing to do so will lose you the teamfight and potentially the game.

## Tips & Tricks
Always basic attack after using a Skill to deal bonus damage with Wukong's passive
Save Skill 1 for blocking important enemy skills
You can use Skill 2 to bounce off minions or teammates to help escape or catch up to enemies

avoid_when: Enemy peel is strong and Wukong cannot reach the backline without dying first
Your team lacks the follow-up damage to convert your control windows into kills
The enemy already drafted Agudo, Gao, and Heino, who counter data identifies as direct answers to Wukong.

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Use Skill 1 Blossoming Fan to clear the minion wave and poke the enemy at the same time. Keep at maximum range of your skills to avoid taking damage. When you have cleared the mid wave, look to roam and use your crowd control with Skill 2 Honeysweet Breeze to impact other lanes and help them get ahead.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, be patient with Skill 2. Hide in bushes and look to knockup up high-value targets, but be sure to stand behind your frontline so you don't get caught. Always stay at maximum range of your skills. Don't walk up to get in range to use Xiao Xiao's ultimate Meteor Storm. This Ultimate should only be used if enemies can't escape or help with damage when being jumped on by assassins

## Tips & Tricks
Standard Combo Skill 2 > Skill 1
Hide in bushes and use Xiao Xiao's combo before enemies see you

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Prioritise pushing Mid Lane and roaming to Farm Lane to help secure jungle camps. Shield your teammates when the enemy is looking to trade damage. 

## Team Fights
Use your Ultimate to catch enemies off guard or to start a teamfight. You can also use it defensively to disengage and stop the enemy from jumping onto your team.

## Tips & Tricks
- Use Frigid Charge after your Ultimate to keep enemies locked in one place
- Attack minions and monsters to charge your passive to get your Ultimate sooner
- Aim your Ultimate towards walls to make it easier to follow up
pros: Mobility to get over walls for vision

avoid_when: The enemy team is loaded with cleanse, dashes, and immunity that bypass crowd control
Your team comp lacks damage and adding another non-damage pick collapses the win condition
A stronger pick in the same role is open and the matchup does not specifically reward Zhang Fei's Crowd Control.

Greeding farm in mid lane while side lanes get camped — rotation timing matters more than CS lead in most matchups.
pick_when: The enemy team plays dive comp, giving you space to poke before they engage
Your team has the structure to use his ability to farm safely and rotate to side lanes when the wave allows, since Ziya delivers consistent damage output and timely roams.
The enemy draft includes Diaochan, Ying, and Zilong, who appear in counter data as matchups Ziya can pressure.
power_spikes: Early game: focus on safe lane phase and tracking jungle pressure before Ziya's mid-game tools come online.
Mana sustain online: poke patterns become repeatable once cooldown reduction and mana regen items come online
Late game: full build online, Ziya reaches the spike public guides describe — extended fights favor him once items are completed.
